meaning.english: Open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning.

example.english: His ambiguous statement left everyone confused.
example.hindi: उसके अस्पष्ट बयान ने सभी को भ्रमित कर दिया।

meaning.english: Became less intense, severe, or widespread.

example.english: The storm abated by morning.
example.hindi: तूफान सुबह तक कम हो गया।

meaning.english: Involving or requiring strenuous effort; difficult and tiring.

example.english: The arduous climb exhausted the hikers.
example.hindi: कठिन चढ़ाई ने पर्वतारोहियों को थका दिया।

meaning.english: To make more beautiful or attractive by adding decorations.

example.english: Flowers adorned the wedding hall.
example.hindi: फूलों ने शादी के हॉल को सजाया।

meaning.english: The top or highest point of something; the peak.

example.english: She reached the apex of her career at thirty.
example.hindi: उसने तीस साल की उम्र में अपने करियर का शीर्ष पाया।

meaning.english: To alter or move something slightly to achieve a better fit or result.

example.english: He adjusted the mirror before driving.
example.hindi: उसने गाड़ी चलाने से पहले शीशा सही किया।

meaning.english: Having little or no rain; very dry.

example.english: Few plants survive in the arid desert.
example.hindi: शुष्क रेगिस्तान में कुछ ही पौधे जीवित रहते हैं।

meaning.english: Having a great deal of money; wealthy.

example.english: The affluent family lived in a large mansion.
example.hindi: धनी परिवार एक बड़े महल में रहता था।

meaning.english: To say or write something in response to a question or situation.

example.english: She answered every question correctly.
example.hindi: उसने हर सवाल का सही जवाब दिया।

meaning.english: To bring to a premature end because of a problem or fault.

example.english: The mission was aborted due to bad weather.
example.hindi: खराब मौसम के कारण मिशन रद्द कर दिया गया।

meaning.english: To make minor changes to a text, law, or document to improve or correct it.

example.english: The committee voted to amend the law.
example.hindi: समिति ने कानून में संशोधन करने के लिए मतदान किया।

meaning.english: To formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution.

example.english: The government abolished the old tax system.
example.hindi: सरकार ने पुरानी कर प्रणाली को समाप्त किया।

meaning.english: To restrain oneself from doing or enjoying something.

example.english: He abstained from voting on the issue.
example.hindi: उसने मुद्दे पर मतदान से परहेज किया।

meaning.english: Lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern.

example.english: Voter apathy led to low turnout.
example.hindi: मतदाता उदासीनता ने कम मतदान का कारण बना।

meaning.english: To offer suggestions about the best course of action.

example.english: The doctor advised him to rest.
example.hindi: डॉक्टर ने उसे आराम करने की सलाह दी।

meaning.english: To make something impure by adding inferior or harmful substances.

example.english: The shopkeeper adulterated the milk with water.
example.hindi: दुकानदार ने दूध में पानी मिलाकर उसे मिलावटी बना दिया।

meaning.english: To repeal or do away with a law, right, or formal agreement.

example.english: The treaty was abrogated by mutual consent.
example.hindi: संधि को आपसी सहमति से रद्द कर दिया गया।

meaning.english: A natural ability or tendency to do something well.

example.english: She showed a great aptitude for mathematics.
example.hindi: उसने गणित में महान योग्यता दिखाई।

meaning.english: To publicly support or recommend a particular cause or policy.

example.english: She advocated for equal rights for all.
example.hindi: उसने सभी के लिए समान अधिकारों की वकालत की।

meaning.english: An award or privilege granted as a special honour or as an acknowledgment of merit.

example.english: The film received the highest accolade at the festival.
example.hindi: फिल्म को महोत्सव में सर्वोच्च पुरस्कार मिला।

meaning.english: Not qualified or diminished in any way; total and complete.

example.english: The king had absolute power over the kingdom.
example.hindi: राजा का राज्य पर पूर्ण अधिकार था।

meaning.english: Filled with great surprise or wonder.

example.english: The audience was amazed by the magician's tricks.
example.hindi: दर्शक जादूगर की चालों से चकित हो गए।

meaning.english: A condition or circumstance that puts one in a favourable position.

example.english: Being bilingual is a great advantage in business.
example.hindi: द्विभाषी होना व्यापार में बड़ा लाभ है।

meaning.english: Having the freedom to act independently; self-governing.

example.english: The autonomous region manages its own affairs.
example.hindi: स्वायत्त क्षेत्र अपने मामलों का प्रबंधन स्वयं करता है।

meaning.english: To attack someone violently or criticize someone strongly.

example.english: Critics assailed the new policy.
example.hindi: आलोचकों ने नई नीति पर हमला बोला।

meaning.english: Possession of the means or skill to do something.

example.english: Her ability to lead inspired the whole team.
example.hindi: उसकी नेतृत्व क्षमता ने पूरी टीम को प्रेरित किया।

meaning.english: To claim or assert that someone has done something illegal or wrong without proof.

example.english: He alleged that the official was corrupt.
example.hindi: उसने आरोप लगाया कि अधिकारी भ्रष्ट था।

example.english: The conditions in the camp were appalling.

meaning.english: To make a public declaration about something.

example.english: The CEO announced the merger at a press conference.
example.hindi: सीईओ ने प्रेस कॉन्फ्रेंस में विलय की घोषणा की।

meaning.english: To gather together or accumulate a large amount of something over time.

example.english: She amassed a fortune through hard work.
example.hindi: उसने कड़ी मेहनत से दौलत इकट्ठी की।

meaning.english: To turn away or prevent something undesirable from happening.

example.english: Quick action averted a disaster.
example.hindi: त्वरित कार्रवाई ने आपदा को टाल दिया।

meaning.english: Showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks; daring.

example.english: The audacious plan caught everyone off guard.
example.hindi: साहसी योजना ने सभी को चौंका दिया।

meaning.english: To shorten a text while retaining the basic content.

example.english: The novel was abridged for younger readers.
example.hindi: उपन्यास को छोटे पाठकों के लिए संक्षिप्त किया गया।

meaning.english: A mixture or blend of different elements.

example.english: The city is an amalgam of cultures.
example.hindi: शहर संस्कृतियों का एक मिश्रण है।

meaning.english: Having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance; conceited.

example.english: His arrogant behaviour offended his colleagues.
example.hindi: उसके अहंकारी व्यवहार ने उसके सहयोगियों को नाराज कर दिया।

meaning.english: Not friendly or forthcoming; cool and distant.

example.english: He remained aloof throughout the party.
example.hindi: वह पूरी पार्टी के दौरान दूर रहा।

meaning.english: Physically and mentally dependent on a particular substance or activity.

example.english: He was addicted to social media.
example.hindi: वह सोशल मीडिया का आदी था।

meaning.english: A whole formed by combining several different elements.

example.english: The aggregate score decided the winner.
example.hindi: कुल अंकों ने विजेता का निर्धारण किया।

meaning.english: Clever or skillful in using the hands or mind.

example.english: She was adroit at handling difficult situations.
example.hindi: वह कठिन परिस्थितियों को संभालने में कुशल थी।

meaning.english: A person, group, or force that opposes or attacks.

example.english: He faced his adversary with courage.
example.hindi: उसने साहस के साथ अपने प्रतिद्वंद्वी का सामना किया।

meaning.english: To change or cause to change in character or composition.

example.english: She altered her dress for the occasion.
example.hindi: उसने अवसर के लिए अपनी पोशाक बदली।

meaning.english: Anxiety or fear that something bad will happen.

example.english: She felt great apprehension before the exam.
example.hindi: परीक्षा से पहले उसे बहुत आशंका हुई।

example.english: The comedian's story was very amusing.
example.hindi: कॉमेडियन की कहानी बहुत मनोरंजक थी।

meaning.english: A purpose or intention; a desired outcome.

example.english: Her aim was to become a doctor.

meaning.english: To give permission for someone to do something.

example.english: She allowed her children to play outside.
example.hindi: उसने अपने बच्चों को बाहर खेलने की अनुमति दी।

meaning.english: To make someone slightly angry; to irritate.

example.english: The noise from outside annoyed him.
example.hindi: बाहर का शोर उसे परेशान कर रहा था।

meaning.english: Engaged in action; characterized by energetic work or movement.

example.english: She leads an active lifestyle.
example.hindi: वह एक सक्रिय जीवनशैली जीती है।

meaning.english: Of or relating to the aristocracy; having the qualities of the aristocracy.

example.english: He had aristocratic manners and bearing.
example.hindi: उसके पास कुलीन व्यवहार और चाल थी।

meaning.english: Clever or cunning devices or expedients, especially to trick or deceive.

example.english: He used artifice to win her trust.
example.hindi: उसने उसका विश्वास जीतने के लिए चालाकी का इस्तेमाल किया।

example.english: The ascendancy was noted by all.

meaning.english: To take in and understand fully; to absorb and integrate.

example.english: It took time to assimilate all the new information.
example.hindi: सारी नई जानकारी को आत्मसात करने में समय लगा।

meaning.english: Taking no account of others' wishes; domineering.

example.english: The autocratic ruler refused all opposition.
example.hindi: निरंकुश शासक ने सभी विरोधों को नकार दिया।

example.english: He avowed his loyalty to the king.
example.hindi: उसने राजा के प्रति अपनी निष्ठा स्वीकार की।

meaning.english: Kind and friendly towards younger or less experienced people.

example.english: His avuncular manner put the students at ease.
example.hindi: उसके चाचा जैसे व्यवहार ने छात्रों को सहज किया।

meaning.english: Away from the expected course; amiss.

example.english: Something had gone awry with the plan.
example.hindi: योजना में कुछ गड़बड़ा गया था।

meaning.english: To attract or tempt by something appealing.

example.english: The city's lights allured the young traveller.
example.hindi: शहर की रोशनी ने युवा यात्री को आकर्षित किया।

meaning.english: To make something larger, stronger, or more detailed.

example.english: The speaker amplified her voice with a microphone.
example.hindi: वक्ता ने माइक्रोफोन से अपनी आवाज बढ़ाई।

meaning.english: Next to or adjoining something else.

example.english: The school is adjacent to the park.
example.hindi: स्कूल पार्क के बगल में है।

meaning.english: Bitterness or ill feeling in speech or manner.

example.english: The debate ended with great acrimony.
example.hindi: बहस बड़ी कटुता के साथ समाप्त हुई।

meaning.english: The process of gathering or acquiring an increasing amount of something.

example.english: The accumulation of wealth took decades.
example.hindi: धन का संचय दशकों में हुआ।

meaning.english: An official agreement or treaty; harmony.

example.english: The two countries signed a peace accord.
example.hindi: दोनों देशों ने एक शांति समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर किए।

meaning.english: A thing added to something else as a supplementary part.

example.english: Exercise is a useful adjunct to a healthy diet.
example.hindi: व्यायाम स्वस्थ आहार का एक उपयोगी पूरक है।

meaning.english: Apt in the circumstances or in relation to something; appropriate.

example.english: She made an apposite remark about the situation.
example.hindi: उसने स्थिति के बारे में उचित टिप्पणी की।

meaning.english: Land that is suitable for or used for growing crops.

example.english: The arable land was perfect for wheat cultivation.
example.hindi: उपजाऊ भूमि गेहूँ की खेती के लिए उपयुक्त थी।

example.english: The aromatic flowers filled the room with fragrance.
example.hindi: सुगंधित फूलों ने कमरे को खुशबू से भर दिया।

meaning.english: Occupation of a position of dominant power or influence.

example.english: The party gained ascendancy after the elections.
example.hindi: चुनाव के बाद पार्टी ने प्रभुत्व हासिल किया।

meaning.english: Of or belonging to the time before the biblical Flood; ridiculously old-fashioned.

example.english: His antediluvian views surprised the young audience.
example.hindi: उसके पुरातन विचारों ने युवा दर्शकों को चौंका दिया।

meaning.english: To evaluate or estimate the nature, ability, or quality of something.

example.english: The teacher assessed each student's progress.
example.hindi: शिक्षक ने प्रत्येक छात्र की प्रगति का मूल्यांकन किया।

meaning.english: An omen or sign of things to come; a portent.

example.english: The black clouds were an augury of the storm.
example.hindi: काले बादल तूफान की भविष्यवाणी थे।

meaning.english: Feeling or showing strong annoyance or displeasure.

example.english: He was angry about the delay.
example.hindi: वह देरी को लेकर गुस्से में था।

meaning.english: The act of renouncing or rejecting something; self-denial.

example.english: Her life was marked by abnegation of personal pleasure.
example.hindi: उसका जीवन व्यक्तिगत सुख के त्याग से चिह्नित था।

meaning.english: The practice of restraining oneself from indulging in something.

example.english: He practised abstinence from alcohol for a year.
example.hindi: उसने एक साल तक शराब से परहेज किया।

meaning.english: A person who encourages or assists someone to do wrong.

example.english: The abettor was arrested along with the criminal.
example.hindi: सहयोगी को अपराधी के साथ गिरफ्तार किया गया।

meaning.english: Ready to accept something without protest; compliant.

example.english: She was too acquiescent to voice her objections.
example.hindi: वह अपनी आपत्तियाँ व्यक्त करने के लिए बहुत आज्ञाकारी थी।

meaning.english: Additional items of dress or equipment carried or worn by a person.
